memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks unaided, manages software work part‑time.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; TUG 9 seconds – normal fall risk.
medicines: 0 regular (none prescribed yet).
mood: Reports good mood, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "Stay active and keep working on my projects."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
alendronate 70 mg PO once weekly
calcium carbonate 500 mg PO BD
colecalciferol (vitamin D3) 1000 IU PO BD
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg inhalation OD
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg inhalation SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhalation BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5)
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 18 ng/mL (30‑100) – low
DEXA lumbar spine T‑score: –2.6
DEXA hip T‑score: –2.4
Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (55% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.58
Chest X‑ray: Hyperinflated lungs, no acute infiltrate

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X‑ray (PA): Bilateral hyperinflation, flattened diaphragms, no pleural effusion or consolidation. Consistent with COPD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent, occasional mild dyspnea on stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (first visit done).
falls: No falls; gait slightly slower; TUG 11 seconds – borderline risk.
medicines: 6 regular (alendronate, calcium, vitamin D, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol). Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports occasional frustration with breathlessness, denies depression.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "Keep walking daily and avoid getting short of breath."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: colecalciferol (vitamin D3) 2000 IU PO BD (increased from 1000 IU BD)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5)
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 32 ng/mL (30‑100) – now sufficient

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages light housework, walks 30 min daily with occasional rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw mild abnormality) – negative screen.
falls: No falls; gait steady; TUG 10 seconds – normal risk.
medicines: 6 regular (same). Polypharmacy – medication review scheduled.
mood: Mood stable, enjoys gardening.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "Maintain independence and enjoy time with grandchildren."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhalation BD (continue)
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg inhalation OD (continue)
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg inhalation SOS (continue)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.55 L (50% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.56 – slight decline from baseline. No acute change.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed more wheezing at night and need my salbutamol inhaler about three times a day. Feeling a bit tired.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Dr S. Reddy, Pulmonology, Apollo Hospitals Bengaluru for evaluation of worsening COPD symptoms and possible escalation of therapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonologist reviewed spirometry and symptoms. Recommended adding inhaled corticosteroid‑long acting beta agonist (fluticasone‑salmeterol 250/50 mcg BD) and continuing current bronchodilators. Advised annual influenza vaccine and pneumococcal booster.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent, able to climb two flights of stairs with mild dyspnea.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (recall 1, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full MoCA assessment.
falls: One fall in past month while reaching for shelf, no injury; gait cautious; TUG 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise home exercise program and non‑slip footwear.
medicines: 7 regular (alendronate, calcium, vitamin D, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, fluticasone-salmeterol). Polypharmacy – medication review urgently needed.
mood: Reports low mood after fall, denies suicidal thoughts.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "Stay safe at home and keep walking without fear of falling."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
alendronate stopped (GI upset)
start calcium carbonate 500 mg PO BD
start colecalciferol (vitamin D3) 2000 IU PO BD
continue tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
continue salbutamol inhaler SOS
continue budesonide-formoterol 200/6 BD
add fluticasone-salmeterol 250/50 mcg inhalation BD

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent, walks 45 min daily, uses walking stick outdoors for stability.
cognition: MoCA score 24/30 – mild cognitive impairment, stable since last assessment.
falls: No falls in past 6 months; gait aided by stick; TUG 11 seconds – borderline risk, continue strength exercises.
medicines: 6 regular (calcium, vitamin D, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, fluticasone-salmeterol). Polypharmacy – annual review completed, no Beers‑flagged meds.
mood: Mood good, enjoys family time.
carers: Spouse, Priya Kulkarni.
goals: "Remain active and enjoy my garden for as long as possible."
